Migrating from base Shiny

Source: vignettes/migrating-inputs.Rmd
migrating-inputs.Rmd

shadshiny is designed to sit on top of an ordinary Shiny app: same inputId in, same input$id out, same reactive graph. Most migrations are a find-and- replace of the UI constructor. This page is the complete map of base Shiny (and common shiny/bslib) UI to its shadshiny counterpart, grouped by area, with the value-shape differences flagged so nothing surprises you server-side.

A handful of base functions have no drop-in — they are render slots (plotOutput, uiOutput) or wiring (fileInput, downloadButton) that shadshiny deliberately doesn’t re-implement. Those rows say so and tell you what to keep. Where shadshiny only restyles the surrounding markup, that is noted too.

Conventions. “drop-in” = same inputId/input$id contract, swap the constructor. “restyle” = keep the base binding, wrap or class it for the shadcn look. “keep base” = no shadshiny equivalent; use the base function.

Inputs

base Shiny shadshiny Kind Notes
textInput() shad_input() drop-in type= for email/password/number/search.
passwordInput() shad_input(type = "password") drop-in —
textAreaInput() shad_textarea() drop-in autosize = TRUE grows with content.
numericInput() shad_number_input() drop-in Numeric value with stepper buttons, min/max/step, and clamping. shad_input(type = "number") is the plainer alternative.
checkboxInput() shad_checkbox() drop-in Adds a tri-state "indeterminate".
checkboxInput() (on/off) shad_switch() drop-in Logical value; the toggle-switch look.
checkboxGroupInput() shad_toggle_group(type = "multiple") drop-in Returns a character vector of selected values.
radioButtons() shad_radio_group() drop-in Single string value.
selectInput() shad_select() drop-in Single value; styled listbox.
selectInput() (plain <select>) shad_native_select() drop-in A styled real <select> — lightest option.
selectInput(multiple = TRUE) shad_combobox(multiple = TRUE) drop-in Searchable; returns a character vector.
selectizeInput() shad_combobox() drop-in Type-ahead search; multiple = for tags.
varSelectInput() shad_select() / shad_combobox() restyle Feed choices = names(data) yourself.
sliderInput() shad_slider() drop-in Two-element value makes it a range.
sliderInput() (range) shad_slider(value = c(lo, hi)) drop-in Returns a length-2 numeric.
dateInput() shad_date_picker() drop-in Value is an ISO "YYYY-MM-DD" string. caption_layout = "dropdown" gives the month/year selects that dateInput() has by default.
dateRangeInput() shad_date_picker(mode = "range") drop-in Value is list(start, end).
— (calendar surface) shad_calendar() new Inline month grid; input$id is the picked date.
— (segmented code) shad_input_otp() new One-time-code entry; no base analogue.
fileInput() shad_dropzone() drop-in Drag-and-drop surface over a hidden fileInput(), so input$id is the same files data frame. Pair with shad_attachment() to render the uploaded-file list.
— (star rating) shad_rating() new Numeric rating; half = TRUE for half-stars.
— (wizard) shad_stepper() (+ shad_step()) new Multi-step flow; input$id is the active step.
— (hierarchy picker) shad_tree() (+ shad_tree_item()) new Tree with selection and input$<id>_expanded.
dateRangeInput() + preset buttons shad_date_picker(mode = "range", presets = shad_date_presets()) drop-in Adds a preset rail (“Last 7 days”, “This month”, …).

Buttons & actions

base Shiny shadshiny Kind Notes
actionButton() shad_button() drop-in Same action-button semantics + variant/size/icon.
actionLink() shad_button(variant = "link") drop-in Link-styled action button.
submitButton() shad_button() + explicit reactivity restyle submitButton is discouraged in modern Shiny; wire observeEvent().
downloadButton() / downloadLink() keep base keep base Needs the downloadHandler binding. Add class = "shad-btn ..." to style it.
toggle button shad_toggle() new Single pressable toggle; input$id is logical.
segmented buttons shad_button_group() new Grouped/segmented button bar.

Layout & page structure

base Shiny / bslib shadshiny Kind Notes
fluidPage() / fillPage() page_shad() drop-in Loads tokens + assets; theme_preset = sets the palette.
titlePanel() shad_h1() (typography set) restyle —
sidebarLayout() / sidebarPanel() / mainPanel() shad_sidebar_layout() drop-in Collapsible app sidebar; input$id reports {collapsed, mobileOpen, active}.
wellPanel() shad_card() (+ parts) restyle Panel/box surface.
fluidRow() / column() CSS grid/flex or page_shad() body restyle Use Bootstrap grid or your own CSS; shadshiny doesn’t reimplement the grid.
splitLayout() / verticalLayout() shad_resizable() (+ panel/handle) restyle Draggable split panes when you want resizing.
conditionalPanel() shad_collapsible() restyle Client-side show/hide; or keep conditionalPanel for JS-expression gating.
hr() shad_separator() drop-in Horizontal or vertical rule.
absolutePanel() / fixedPanel() keep base keep base Positioning helpers; no shadcn analogue.
bslib::card() shad_card() drop-in Header/title/description/content/footer parts.
bslib::value_box() shad_value_box() drop-in KPI card with trend delta chip, icon, and a sparkline slot.
bslib::accordion() shad_accordion() (+ item) drop-in type = "single"|"multiple".

Navigation

base Shiny / bslib shadshiny Kind Notes
tabsetPanel() / tabPanel() shad_tabs() / shad_tab() drop-in input$id is the active tab value.
navbarPage() page_shad() + shad_navigation_menu() or shad_sidebar_layout() restyle Compose the shell yourself.
navlistPanel() shad_sidebar_layout() restyle Sidebar nav; observe input$id$active.
bslib::navset_*() shad_tabs() / shad_navigation_menu() restyle —
breadcrumb (manual) shad_breadcrumb() (+ item/separator) new —
paging controls (manual) shad_pagination() new input$id is the current page.

Overlays & modals

base Shiny shadshiny Kind Notes
modalDialog() + showModal() / removeModal() shad_dialog() in UI + shad_dialog_open() / shad_dialog_close() pattern shift Define the dialog in the UI, toggle by id from the server (not built server-side).
destructive confirm modal shad_alert_dialog() + _open() / _close() new Purpose-built confirm/cancel dialog.
off-canvas / bslib::*_sidebar slide-over shad_sheet() + _open() / _close() new Edge sheet panel.
bottom sheet shad_drawer() + _open() / _close() new —
bslib::popover() shad_popover() + _open() / _close() drop-in —
bslib::tooltip() shad_tooltip() drop-in Hover/focus tooltip.
hover preview shad_hover_card() new Rich hover card.
dropdown menu shad_dropdown_menu() (+ items) new Menu, checkbox/radio items, submenus.
right-click menu shad_context_menu() new —
app menubar shad_menubar() (+ menu) new —
⌘K palette shad_command() (+ group/item) new Grouped, keyword-searchable command palette.

Notifications & feedback

base Shiny shadshiny Kind Notes
showNotification() shad_toast() (+ _success/_error/_warning) drop-in Server-raised toasts.
showNotification(type = "message", duration = NULL) (loading) shad_toast_loading() → shad_toast_update() drop-in Loading→done flow; pass session from deferred callbacks.
removeNotification() shad_toast_dismiss() drop-in —
withProgress() / Progress$new() / incProgress() shad_progress() + update_shad_progress() pattern shift Determinate bar you drive by id; wrap your own loop.
insertUI() / removeUI() keep base keep base Works as-is — inserted shadshiny components auto-initialise.
validate() / need() shad_validator() (+ shad_rules) pattern shift Declare rules per field; the validator drives aria-invalid and inline shad_form_message() text. Base validate()/need() still works for output gating.

Outputs & display

base Shiny shadshiny Kind Notes
tableOutput() / renderTable() shad_table() (+ parts) via renderUI() restyle shad_table is static markup; build rows from your data and renderUI().
dataTableOutput() / DT / reactable shad_data_table() drop-in Client-side sort/filter/page/select, styled to the theme. input$id reports {selected, sort, filter, page, pageSize}; refresh with update_shad_data_table(). Keep DT when you need server-side paging over large data.
plotOutput() / renderPlot() keep base, inside shad_chart_container() keep base Card wrapper with title/description/legend. Theme the plot with shad_theme_ggplot2() + shad_current_theme().
plotly / echarts4r widgets keep base, inside shad_chart_container() keep base Restyle with shad_theme_plotly() / shad_theme_echarts4r(). The plot adapters are experimental.
event log / activity feed (manual) shad_timeline() (+ item) new —
uiOutput() / renderUI() keep base keep base Render slot; emit shadshiny tags into it — they auto-initialise.
textOutput() / verbatimTextOutput() keep base keep base Wrap in shad_code() / typography for styling.
icon() (Font Awesome) shad_icon() drop-in Lucide set; see vignette("icons"). Any custom SVG also accepted.
progressBar (manual) shad_progress() new Determinate progress bar.
avatar / badge (manual) shad_avatar() / shad_badge() new —
skeleton / spinner (manual) shad_skeleton() / shad_spinner() new Loading placeholders.

Typography & static content

base Shiny / htmltools shadshiny Notes
h1()–h4() shad_h1()–shad_h4() Tuned type scale.
p() shad_p() —
tags$blockquote() shad_blockquote() —
helpText() shad_muted() / shad_small() Muted helper text.
strong() / lead text shad_lead() / shad_large() —
code() shad_code() Inline code.
tags$kbd() shad_kbd() Keyboard key.
tags$ul() / tags$li() shad_list() Styled list; pass tags$li() children, ordered = TRUE for <ol>.

shadshiny-only — no base equivalent

Worth adopting on their own; there is nothing to migrate from:

  • shad_command() — ⌘K command palette with grouped, keyword-searchable items.
  • shad_input_otp() — segmented one-time-code entry.
  • shad_sidebar_layout() — full collapsible application sidebar with groups, items, badges, and a server-toggled state.
  • shad_toast() — server-raised notifications, including loading→done flows.
  • The chat / AI kit — shad_bubble(), shad_message() (+ scroller), shad_attachment(), shad_marker() — a stick-to-bottom streaming transcript, or shad_chat_ui() / shad_chat_server() for the whole module at once.
  • shad_theme() / shad_theme_from_registry() — build a custom palette, or import one from the shadcn theme registry (experimental).
  • shad_empty() — empty-state panel; shad_item() — flex list-row primitive.

Value-shape differences to watch

  • Multi-value inputs return character vectors. shad_combobox(multiple = TRUE) and shad_toggle_group(type = "multiple") give you c("a", "b"), not a comma-joined string.
  • Range inputs return structured values. shad_slider(value = c(20, 80)) reports c(20, 80); shad_date_picker(mode = "range") reports list(start = ..., end = ...).
  • Dates are ISO strings. Convert with as.Date(input$id) when you need a Date.
  • Checkbox tri-state. shad_checkbox() can report "indeterminate" in addition to TRUE/FALSE; guard with isTRUE(input$id). Users can only click back to it when the checkbox has tristate = TRUE.
  • Overlays are UI-defined, server-toggled. Unlike showModal(), a shad_dialog() lives in the UI and you open/close it by id (shad_dialog_open("confirm")) — Shiny-module safe via the session’s ns.

Updating from the server

Base updateXxxInput() calls become update_shad_*(), one per valued component:

# base Shiny
updateSelectInput(session, "plan", selected = "pro")
updateSliderInput(session, "range", value = c(10, 40))
updateCheckboxInput(session, "agree", value = TRUE)
updateTabsetPanel(session, "tabs", selected = "billing")

# shadshiny
update_shad_select("plan", selected = "pro")
update_shad_slider("range", value = c(10, 40))
update_shad_switch("agree", value = TRUE)
update_shad_tabs("tabs", selected = "billing")

The full set: update_shad_input_otp(), update_shad_checkbox(), update_shad_switch(), update_shad_radio_group(), update_shad_select(), update_shad_native_select(), update_shad_combobox(), update_shad_slider(), update_shad_date_picker(), update_shad_calendar(), update_shad_toggle(), update_shad_toggle_group(), update_shad_button(), update_shad_tabs(), update_shad_accordion(), update_shad_pagination(), update_shad_carousel(), update_shad_sidebar(), update_shad_progress(), and update_shad_theme(). See ?update_shad and the server API guide for the overlay controllers and the shad_toast() family.
